messages:
jess: quick lunchtime poll — sushi / salad / leftovers? Vote with emoji or reply. I'll tally at 12:30. :sushi: = sushi, :green_salad: = salad, :bento_box: = leftovers

dev-bot: Created poll (options: :sushi:, :green_salad:, :bento_box:) — react to vote

sam: salad for me today! 🥗

courtney: leftovers (curry in fridge) — saving money :money_with_wings:

liam: sushi please :sushi:

olivia: sashimi counts as sushi, right? :raised_hands: @jess

matt: voted :green_salad:

jess: quick tally so far — sushi: 2, salad: 2, leftovers: 1

sam: can we get vegan sushi? :thinking_face:

courtney: @sam there's a veggie roll spot nearby :ok_hand:

liam: placing order after tally

dev-bot: Reminder: tally at 12:30 (in 10 minutes)

olivia: added :bento_box: as backup in case the sushi place runs out

matt: :thumbsup:

jess: final count — sushi: 2 (liam, olivia), salad: 3 (sam, matt, me), leftovers: 1 (courtney) — salad wins! Ordering now :salad:

courtney: congrats salad team :tada:

liam: next time i'm bringing sashimi samples :chef:

dev-bot: Order placed: 3x salad, 1x sushi, 1x leftovers — ETA 25–35 mins
